title: phyllanthus maderaspatensis var. thonningii
intro: Phyllanthus maderaspatensis var. thonningii, commonly known as the West African or Madagascar Phyllanthus, is a plant species of the Phyllanthus genus. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including liver and kidney diseases, fever, and skin infections, due to its health benefits of promoting liver detoxification, reducing inflammation, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating liver and kidney disorders. The bioactive constituents of Phyllanthus maderaspatensis var. thonningii include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
